creator: Navneet Prabhakar
scope: Three handcrafted development probes, not a reviewed acceptance suite or a population estimate.

messages.content: Reply with exactly the word blue.
My name is Mira. Please remember it.
What is my name? Reply with only the name.
What is 2 plus 3? Reply with only the number.

limitations: The model has prose-only foundation training, not conversation SFT. The supplied prior assistant turn is a handcrafted fixture, not a generated teacher response. Results can seed actual student-failure investigation; they do not establish broad capability or authorize training on generated outputs.
